effects.lua_implementation: Single CANNOT_SUMMON and CANNOT_MSET effects register the explicit restrictions.

official_references.matched_structure: The Winged Dragon of Ra uses explicit Normal Summon/Set restrictions for a special summon class.

effects.printed_clause: Must first be Special Summoned from hand by banishing a To Proto monster you control.
effects.lua_implementation: Revive limit plus SPSUMMON_CONDITION restrict first summon; a hand SPSUMMON_PROC selects one face-up controlled set monster that opens a zone and banishes it as cost.

official_references.card_name: Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning
official_references.matched_structure: Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning uses a hand Special Summon procedure paid by banishing monsters.

effects.printed_clause: Main Phase Quick Effect: Tribute a Protogenic Essence Token; negate a face-up monster.
effects.lua_implementation: Main-Phase quick effect releases exact Token as cost, targets a face-up monster and installs DISABLE/DISABLE_EFFECT with standard reset.

official_references.matched_structure: Baronne de Fleur supplies official quick negation structure; Lonefire supplies Tribute cost.
Uses release/Tribute of a controlled monster as activation cost.

effects.printed_clause: Then this card gains ATK/DEF equal to that monster’s current ATK/DEF.
effects.lua_implementation: Resolution snapshots nonnegative current stats before negation and grants permanent UPDATE_ATTACK/DEFENSE to the related handler.

official_references.matched_structure: The Winged Dragon of Ra uses paired ATK/DEF gain equal to a captured numeric value.

effects.printed_clause: If the gain occurs, increase all effects’ turn count by 1.
effects.lua_implementation: The operation increments Card TurnCounter values on cards in accessible locations, which covers conventional card-maintained turn counters but cannot enumerate or advance arbitrary effect-local reset durations.

official_references.matched_structure: Pyro Clock of Destiny is the closest official card: it advances the global turn count by one while the current turn continues.

effects.issue: Unresolved engine/design gap: Omega exposes card turn counters, not a universal collection of every effect's remaining turn duration. The printed phrase 'all effect's turn count' needs a narrower ruling or engine support.

effects.printed_clause: If banished from field: target a differently named banished To Proto monster; add it to hand.
effects.lua_implementation: Delayed EVENT_REMOVE requires previous on-field location, targets face-up own banished set monster excluding this code, then adds/confirms it.

official_references.matched_structure: Giant Rex uses a delayed EVENT_REMOVE trigger with previous-location/banished-card handling.

effects.printed_clause: Each activated effect is once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: Quick effect and banished trigger use id/id+100.

official_references.matched_structure: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring supplies named HOPT structure.
